data.one_liner: Retrieve and manage device contacts on Android and iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing full CRUD operations for device contacts. It allows reading, searching, adding, updating, and deleting contacts, as well as handling avatars and native contact forms.
use_when: You need to read and search contacts from the device's address book.
Your app requires creating, updating, or deleting contacts natively.
You want to integrate native contact forms and pickers on iOS and Android.
avoid_when: You need a package that handles runtime permissions out-of-the-box.
Targeting platforms other than iOS and Android.
strengths: Supports full CRUD operations on contacts.
Provides access to native contact forms and avatars.
Cross-platform support for iOS and Android.
weaknesses: Does not handle permission requests automatically; requires third-party packages.
iOS minimum deployment target is restricted to 13.0+.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding READ_CONTACTS and WRITE_CONTACTS permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and NSContactsUsageDescription to Info.plist on iOS. You must also handle permissions separately using a package like permission_handler.
